text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. No Crime Record * 2. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 3. Bank Statement * 4. CV(with photo) Written in Chinese or in English 5. For In-country and Extension Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Proof of current enrollment Transcript for the current academic period Explanation of extension circumstances 6. For In-country Transfer Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Transfer certificate/No objection certificate Verification statement Transcript from the previous school Admission letter (in Chinese and English) * 7. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Notarized highest degree transcripts, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. 1.Transcripts that are not in Chinese or English must be translated into Chinese and then notarized. 2.After notarization, they must also be authenticated by the local Chinese embassy or consulate (for countries that are part of the Hague Convention, an Apostille is required). 3.You must bring the original transcripts, as well as the original notarization and authentication documents, when reporting for registration. Otherwise, you will not be able to complete the registration. * 10. Notarized highest degree graduation certificate, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. For students from countries joined Hague Conventions could provide apostille documents. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English need to be translated into Chinese during notarization, and make sure you bring all original application documents including these to China during registration. * 11. Two letters of recommendation Written in English from two respectable professors. including professors' contact no, email address and handwritten signature * 12. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. * 13. A Supervision Confirmation Letter issued by professors or associate professors More about the supervisor contact information: http://iec.dmu.edu.cn/gyxy/Faculty.htm 14. Qublications(catalogue or abstract) Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
